data.reason_zh: 训练无关的推理期帧压缩方法，无反馈驱动的自我修改，也无跨轮次改进继承。

scope_support.exclusion_quote: FramePack-U requires no fine-tuning or architectural modification -- it plugs directly into off-the-shelf VLMs at inference time.
scope_support.object_quote: We propose FramePack-U, a strikingly simple, training-free frame packing framework that compresses arbitrarily long videos into a fixed size visual representation at constant memory cost.
